description: If you want a large house and a large yard, wonderful. If you want an apartment or condo, those options should exist too. And if you want a beautiful, permanently constructed home on a smaller lot in a walkable neighborhood where you actually know the people living around you... why shouldn't that choice exist? For land-constrained communities like Menasha, Neenah, and Fox Crossing, Heritage Homes could give us another tool. They could provide more opportunities for homeownership, more choice
